items.headline: Manchester United beat Ipswich Town 5-2 at Old Trafford
items.summary: Man United secured a convincing 5-2 home victory against Ipswich Town in recent Premier League action. Bruno Fernandes scored including a penalty.

items.headline: Baleba signing completed for £65m plus £5m add-ons
items.summary: Manchester United complete the acquisition of Baleba from Brighton after years of pursuit. The midfielder arrives as part of their summer rebuild.
